sloka: चर्यमाणम् तपस् तीव्रम् सम्तापयति राक्षसान् ।देवदानवयक्षेभो गृहीतश्च वरस्त्वया ॥६-३५-२३॥।।
transliteration: caryamāṇam tapas tīvram samtāpayati rākṣasān ।devadānavayakṣebho gṛhītaśca varastvayā ॥6-35-23॥।।

translations.english: "You have secured boons of immunity against death at the hand s of strong and mighty and powerful valour, like gods, Danavas, Yakshas and human beings. The Vanaras, Bears and monkeys with dark faces are coming here now thundering."
